info.name: United Services Egypt — API
info.description:
Full API coverage for the United Services Egypt backend (NestJS).

## Auth
This app authenticates via a Clerk session — either the `__session` cookie (browser) or an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header (what this collection uses). Set the collection variable `sessionToken` to a live Clerk session token (e.g. copy it from your browser's dev tools → Application → Cookies → `__session`, or call `await getToken()` in the frontend console while signed in) before running any authenticated request. Tokens are short-lived — you'll need to refresh it periodically.

## CSRF
Every state-changing request (POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE) requires the header `X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest` — already added to every such request in this collection, except `POST /webhooks/clerk` which is explicitly exempt.

## Roles
Folders are organized by feature; each request's description states which role (client / candidate / admin / public / any authenticated user) it requires. Sign in as the right role in your browser first, then copy that session's token, to test role-restricted endpoints.

## Path variables
Replace `:id` (and similar) segments and the `{{...}}` variables in request bodies/paths with real values from your database, or run the corresponding "list"/"create" requests first.

request.description: Public + CSRF-exempt, but requires valid Svix signature headers (svix-id, svix-timestamp, svix-signature) verified against CLERK_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Cannot be meaningfully tested from Postman directly — use Clerk's own webhook test tool, or the `svix` CLI, to generate a correctly signed request against this endpoint.
